title: 第十章：引气入体
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

经过一个晚上的调查苏行风和那个女人算是没什么事了，公安局这边本来是说要给他颁发一个见义勇为奖的，然而在医院那边一了解，这家伙下手也太重了，所以这功过相低给了个口头嘉奖。

“小苏啊！以后要是再遇上这种事，还是先和我们的人联系一下，要不然也别出手这么重啊！”

他们大队长亲自把他送出大门口说道。从这个大队长调查，他知道苏行枫是退伍军人，但是他一查却查不下去了，因为他权限不够，经事多年的他知道，他不能再查下去了，再查就出事了，他很聪明的知道，这个苏行枫很是不简单。

“秦大队，当时的情况，现场你可是看到了的啊！我要是不出手儿狠点，这倒下的可是我啊！呵呵！我可不想啊！你看看我这么年青还没女朋友呢！”

他笑着对秦大队说着，还开玩笑似的翻了个白眼，无奈的耸了耸肩，两手掌一摊。

“这....呵呵！那行吧！以后多注意些，有什么事还是先和我们联系，反正电话你也留了，只要有什么紧急事件，一个电话我们马上就到。那就到这吧！你们也回去好好休息.....”

秦大队把他们送到局大门**待几句就回去了。

“萱姐，我们打个的回去吧！现在才六点多，想必那边的摊子还没收拾吧？”

“好吧！行枫，谢谢你！这次要不.....”

“萱姐这话都说了一个晚上了，再这样我可会不高兴的啊！走吧！”

两个人拦了辆的士就往回走。经过这一个晚上两个人熟悉了很多，萱姐原名周寒萱，原本嫁了个好老公，可是在前年一次车祸中去世。

现在自己在他出租房那门口摆了个夜宵摊，另外更大一点的男女是他老公的哥哥和嫂子，另一个青年是他的弟弟，现正上大学。

昨晚就因为自已上菜时上错了，才造成那场群斗的。当时公安询问中问到此事时也吃了一惊，就因为一盘菜上错，这引来的双方群欧也太让人惊掉下巴了吧！但也就因为这样，把市里的一件持枪伤人案件牵引了出来，要不然还破不了案呢！他们也不知道是说她运气好还是不好呢？

回去后那边的夜宵摊都收完了，几个人或蹲或站的在那焦急的等着。当见到他和萱姐从的士车下来后就跑了过来。

“姐...呜...呜”

“寒萱...”

“萱，让你受委屈了...呜...”

一阵驱寒问暧后，她给大家介绍了一下苏行枫，他把大家拉进自己的出租房内坐了一会儿，他们走的时候，这边还嘱咐她，让她这几天多注意自己的左手，随后他也就穿越回星空界部落里。

这边也刚才天黑，自己正好休息一下，正好这小叶紫檀散发出的清香让他没一会就睡着了。

“强子，这肉是什么肉啊？”

休息好后中午才起来，让强子准备了吃的。

“大人，这是夜光鹿的肉，这都是部落里养的，大人要是喜欢吃我再给你多做点。”

“夜光鹿？那是什么鹿？，是它们晚上会发光吗？这东西很好养吗？”

他想起刚才来时，在丛林中发现的那种长的像马又像鹿的那种动物，因为当时他看到那东西很大一只，所以他不敢去惹它，但发现时那个时候正是白天，也就没机会知道是不是会发光。

吃饱后他让强子带着他去看一下。

“大人，就是这种，就和大人所说的一样，晚上它身上那些斑点会发出荧光，很好看的，它们的角是种药材，它的血可以用来炼体，我们现在身上穿的就是用它的皮做的，很柔软但同时很坚韧的”

“还真是这种鹿啊！怎么这养的这么大啊？”

他看着眼前一片大大的丛林中一大群的，在树与树之间还绑上了围栏。走前去仔细看着，才发现这TM的也太大了吧！我们常说，瘦死的骆驼比马大，但这家伙要比骆驼还要大一大半。

Page (1/3)

After a night of investigation, Su Xingfeng and the woman were fine. The Public Security Bureau originally said that they would give him a bravery award. However, when they learned about it at the hospital, they found that this guy was too harsh, so they gave him a verbal award based on merit.

"Xiao Su! If you encounter this kind of thing again in the future, you'd better contact our people first, otherwise don't be so harsh!"

Their captain personally escorted him out of the gate and said.From the captain's investigation, he knew that Su Xingfeng was a veteran, but he could not continue the investigation because he did not have enough authority. After many years of experience, he knew that he could not continue the investigation, otherwise something would happen. He was very smart and knew that this Su Xingfeng was not simple.

"Qin Brigade, you saw the situation at that time! If I hadn't been more ruthless, I would have fallen! Haha! I didn't want to! Look at me, I'm so young and I don't have a girlfriend!"

He smiled and said to Captain Qin, rolled his eyes as if joking, shrugged helplessly, and spread his palms.

"This...hehe! That's okay! Pay more attention in the future and contact us first if anything happens. Anyway, you have left your phone number. As long as there is any emergency, we will be there immediately after just one call. Then stay here! You guys should go back and have a good rest..."

Brigade Qin sent them to the bureau gate and waited for a few words before going back.

"Sister Xuan, let's go back together! It's only after six o'clock now, so the stalls over there must not have been cleared yet, right?"

"Okay! Xing Feng, thank you! How about this time..."

"Sister Xuan has been saying this all night. I won't be happy if she does this again! Let's go!"

The two people hailed a taxi and headed back.After this night, the two got to know each other a lot. Sister Xuan's real name was Zhou Hanxuan. She was married to a good husband, but she died in a car accident the year before last.

Now he has set up a late-night snack stall in front of his rental house. The other older men and women are his husband's brother and sister-in-law, and the other young man is his younger brother, who is now in college.

Last night, it was because I served the wrong food, which led to the group fight.When the police asked about this during the interrogation, they were also surprised. Just because one dish was served wrong, the crowd from both sides was so shocking!But just because of this, a case of wounding someone with a gun in the city was brought out, otherwise the case would not have been solved!They don't know whether they say she is lucky or not?

After I returned home, all the late-night snack stalls there were closed, and a few people were squatting or standing there waiting anxiously.When she saw him and Sister Xuan getting off the taxi, they ran over.

"Sister...wu...wu"

"Hanxuan..."

"Xuan, I've made you feel wronged... ugh..."

After a while of warming up, she introduced Su Xingfeng to everyone. He pulled everyone into his rental room and sat there for a while. When they left, he also asked her to pay more attention to her left hand these days, and then he traveled back to the starry sky realm tribe.

It was getting dark here just now, so he happened to take a rest. The fragrance of the small-leaf red sandalwood made him fall asleep soon.

"Qiangzi, what kind of meat is this?"

After resting, he got up at noon and asked Qiangzi to prepare food.

"Sir, this is the meat of Luminous Deer, which is raised by the tribe. If you like to eat it, I will make more for you."

"Glow-in-the-dark deer? What kind of deer are they? Do they glow at night? Is this thing easy to raise?"

He remembered the animal that looked like a horse and a deer that he had found in the jungle when he came here. Because he saw that the thing was very big at the time, he did not dare to mess with it, but it was daytime when he found it, so he had no chance to know whether it would glow.

After eating, he asked Qiangzi to take him to see it.

"Sir, this is it. It's just like what you said. The spots on its body will fluoresce at night. It's very beautiful. Their horns are a kind of medicinal material. Its blood can be used to refine the body. What we are wearing now is made of its skin. It is very soft but very tough at the same time."

"What a deer! Why are they so big?"

He looked at a large group of people in a large jungle in front of him, with fences tied between the trees.When I walked forward and took a closer look, I realized that this damn thing was too big!We often say that a skinny camel is bigger than a horse, but this guy is more than half the size of a camel.
